benchmark_method: ETF gross total-return proxy from unadjusted close plus official ex-date cash dividend; fractional reinvestment, no fees. Not CSI300 or official bond index returns.
beta_method: Last 252 paired daily returns, sample covariance / benchmark variance; insufficient forward samples remain null.
holdings_method: Q3 disclosed codes grouped by verified issue; lower bounds at disclosure date applied to account ETF value.
stress_method: Fixed hypothetical one-step ETF price shocks; no probability, liquidation, rebalancing, liquidity or convexity model. Chosen before computing outputs, not optimized.
